riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work combines aesthetics, practicality, and negotiation. Products must look good and work well, while designers account for cost and tooling and communicate tradeoffs clearly.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops practical judgment within aesthetics. Designers need a sense of form and materials, plus the engineering awareness to fit designs within molds and cost targets. It suits aesthetically aware, focused people who will negotiate for manufacturable outcomes and enjoy the full process from sketch to store shelf.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers creative, practical, and investigative work (Artistic A + Enterprising E + Realistic R).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「审美 + 务实 + 能扯皮」凑一块的人——产品要好用也要好看，成本和模具要算清也要会说。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「审美里的务实」——既要懂形态与材质算得美，也要有把设计落进模具和成本的工程感。适合有审美、坐得住、又愿意为量产扯皮的人，也享受从草图到货架的全过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好创造、务实、也钻研（艺术 A + 企业 E + 现实 R）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Computer and information systems management is worth considering if you remain curious about technology and accept the need to make high-stakes judgments.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to translate between technology and business. Managers need to explain ROI to executives while protecting technical teams from poor decisions. It suits people with programming experience who also want to manage people and budgets.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers business decisions, analysis, and establishing new rules and order (Enterprising E + Investigative I + Conventional C).

breadcrumb.label: 计算机与信息系统经理

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Computer and information systems managers有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，计算机与信息系统经理适合谁？值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在技术与生意之间翻译」——既要让老板听懂 ROI，也要护住团队不被瞎指挥。适合既写过程序、又愿意管人管钱的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好经营决策、也重分析与新规秩序（企业 E + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Computer support suits people who combine care, patience, and plain-language communication. You must diagnose faults clearly, explain solutions, balance technology with communication, and enjoy helping others.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops the ability to translate technical language into plain English. You need underlying technical knowledge and the patience to calm frustrated users. It suits careful people who enjoy helping others and seeing a problem move from broken to fixed.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Practical, investigative, and people-oriented interests (Realistic R + Investigative I + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 耐心 + 能把术语翻成人话」凑一块的人——故障要排得清也要讲得懂，技术和沟通要平衡也要会帮人。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把术语翻成人话」——既要懂底层原理，也要有把着急的用户安抚下来的耐心。适合细心、爱帮人、又坐得住的人，也享受从「坏了」到「好了」的闭环。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、研究、也助人（实务 R + 研究 I + 社会 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: Computer Systems Engineers/Architects are worth considering if you stay curious about the field and accept responsibility for decisions under high risk.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops the ability to see the whole system. You must examine individual details while tracking the full chain. It suits people with strong systems thinking who weigh tradeoffs and can carry technical debt responsibly.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers research and analysis, hands-on implementation, and clear standards (Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Computer Systems Engineers/Architects有持续好奇、又不排斥高风险下的判断，工程师计算机值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「看见全局」——既要钻得进单点，也要抬得头看全链路。适合系统思维强、爱权衡、能扛技术债的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好研究分析、动手实现、也重规范（研究 I + 现实 R + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who pursue clinical craft for its own sake. A precisely placed implant or a clean impacted-tooth extraction makes technical mastery rewarding.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The satisfaction comes from completing difficult cases. A dentist can use a digital guide to place an implant that others would not attempt, then see the patient's bite return to normal. That outcome builds a distinctive kind of professional confidence.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手艺」当追求的人——一个完美的种植体、一次漂亮的埋伏牙拔除，技术本身就是最大的乐趣来源。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的成就感来自「把复杂病例做下来」：一个别人都不敢接的高难度种植，你在数字化导板的辅助下稳稳完成，患者咬合恢复正常的那一刻，那种专业自信是其他岗位给不了的。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 实际型 R + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine steady hands, patience, and sensitivity to proportion. Fit requires repeated adjustment, and a detail that is one centimeter off can ruin the entire garment.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work suits people who can sit with a task, keep a steady hand, and intuitively understand pattern shape and proportion. It works well when garment comfort is the standard.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Artistic A + Investigative I: practical, creative, and analytical.

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「手稳 + 坐得住 + 对比例敏感」凑一块的人——合身要反复调，细节差一厘米整件废。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行适合坐得住、手稳、对版型和比例有直觉的人。你愿意把「一件衣服穿得舒服」当标准，这活就顺。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、艺术、也研究（现实 R + 艺术 A + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation suits people who combine hands-on ability, aesthetics, and patience. They can repeatedly refine one finish and distinguish subtle warm and cool color differences.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most rewarding part of this occupation is visible transformation. A damaged old board becomes smooth and bright again through your hands. It suits people who can stay focused, keep a steady hand, and care about color and texture, with tangible results after each project.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on, practical work and investigation (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「动手 + 审美 + 耐心」凑一块的人——能为一层漆面反复打磨，也分得清冷暖色差。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最治愈的是「看得见的变化」——一块坑坑洼洼的旧木板，经你手重新变得平整发亮。适合坐得住、手稳、对颜色和质感有要求的人，干完一件能真真切切摸到成果。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实操、重现实、也爱钻研（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This occupation combines practical service, business awareness, and rule adherence. Accounts must stay accurate, customers must remain calm, and workers balance detail with communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This occupation develops precision and composure. Workers must avoid errors around funds and rules while managing customer emotions. It suits practical, careful people who follow procedures, handle pressure, and enjoy resolving each transaction correctly.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social, enterprising, and conventional interests (Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「务实 + 经营 + 守规」凑一块的人——账要清、客要稳、细心和规矩要平衡也要会沟通。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「细和稳」——要在钱与规则里不出错，也要把客人的情绪接住。适合务实、细心、能守规矩、耐压的人，也享受把一局局理顺的那一下。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、经营、也守规则（社会 S + 经营 E + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Janitors And Cleaners, Except Maids And Housekeeping Cleaners

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This industry is suitable for people who combine "diligence + stability + vision" - the environment must be clean and safe, and scanning and inspection must be balanced and able to read.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This line of work requires "steadiness and eyesight" the most - you need to be diligent, but you also need to be able to see where the dirt is and where the hidden dangers are. Suitable for people who are steady, diligent and not afraid of repetition.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: More pragmatic, conventional and social (Pragmatic R + Conventional C + Social S).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「勤快 + 稳重 + 眼力」凑一块的人——环境要净也要安全，扫和检要平衡也要会看。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「踏实和眼力」——既要手脚勤，也要看得见脏在哪、隐患在哪。适合稳重、勤快、不怕重复的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏务实、常规与社会（务实 R + 常规 C + 社会 S）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine steadiness + attention to detail + empathy. When families are most vulnerable, you provide dignity and reassurance.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops the ability to preserve dignity amid grief. It requires embalming and restorative skills as well as the emotional intelligence to support families through ceremonies. It suits steady, careful, empathetic people who accept the quiet importance of work that others need.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping, practical, and enterprising work (Social S + Realistic R + Enterprising E).

breadcrumb.label: 殡葬师、殡仪承办人、殡葬安排员

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「稳重 + 细心 + 有同理」凑一块的人——家属最脆弱时，你给的是体面和安心。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「在悲伤里保持体面」——既要会防腐整容的手艺，也要有陪家属撑过仪式的情商。适合稳重、细心、有同理的人，也接受这是一份被需要的安静工作。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、也务实、也企业（社会 S + 现实 R + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine rigor + steadiness + responsibility. Readings require sustained monitoring and accurate assessment, while procedures and safety thresholds must be balanced and upheld.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops precision and steadiness. Readings must be monitored, procedures followed rigidly, and anomalies reported accurately. It suits rigorous people who sustain concentration, believe in safety, and value the responsibility of protecting the baseline.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, investigative, and orderly work (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「严谨 + 稳重 + 有责任感」凑一块的人——读数要盯得住也要判得准，规程和底线要平衡也要守住。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「细致与稳重」——读数要盯得住，规程要守得死，异常要报得准。适合严谨、坐得住、对安全有信仰的人，也享受守护底线的责任感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、研究、也守序（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: If you remain curious about Nuclear Technicians work and are comfortable making judgments under moderate risk, this occupation is worth considering.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This field develops the ability to internalize procedures. Technicians must understand systems while maintaining zero tolerance for safety failures. It suits calm, rigorous people who perform well under pressure.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers hands-on implementation, research and analysis, and clear standards (Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 如果你对Nuclear Technicians有持续好奇、又不排斥中风险下的判断，核技术员值得考虑。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「把规程刻进骨头」——既要懂系统，也要对安全零容忍。适合冷静、严谨、抗压的人。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好动手实现、研究分析、也重规范（现实 R + 研究 I + 常规 C）。

breadcrumb.label: Outdoor Power Equipment And Other Small Engine Mechanics

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who enjoy wrestling with machines. Bringing a lawn mower that someone else declared beyond repair back to a steady roar feels more tangible than completing a video game.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The interesting part of this field is that every machine fails differently. Two lawn mowers of the same model can have entirely different faults: one has a blocked fuel system, the other a failed ignition coil. You infer the problem from sound, smell, and touch. The moment an old machine starts after repair delivers immediate satisfaction.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Investigative I + Conventional C

breadcrumb.label: 户外动力设备其他小型发动机机械师

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「跟机器较劲能较出乐趣」的人——一台别人判了死刑的割草机，在你手里重新嗡鸣起来，那种感觉比打游戏通关实在多了。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最有意思的是「每台机器坏得都不一样」：同一型号的割草机，这台是油路堵了，那台是点火线圈挂了，你得靠声音、味道和手感去猜毛病。修好一台老机器启动的那一下，成就感很直接。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 现实型 R + 研究型 I + 常规型 C

breadcrumb.label: Photographic Process Workers And Processing Machine Operators

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This work suits people who combine attention to detail + sustained focus + comfort with machinery. Hands must be steady, eyes sharp, and temperament patient.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This work develops tactile skill and visual judgment. You must understand chemical ratios and machine timing and spot color casts and scratches instantly. It suits careful people who can stay focused and enjoy working with machinery while accepting that digital technology is rewriting the field.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, orderly, and investigative work (Realistic R + Conventional C + Investigative I).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「细心 + 坐得住 + 跟机器打交道」凑一块的人——手要稳、眼要毒、性要耐。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「手感和眼力」——既要懂药液配比和机器节拍，也要能一眼看出色偏和划痕。适合细心、坐得住、又愿意跟机器打交道的人，也接受这行正在被数字浪潮改写。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、讲秩序、也探究（现实 R + 事务 C + 研究 I）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people who combine reliability, attention to detail, and a service mindset. Mail must be organized clearly and delivered accurately, while procedures and service must be balanced through effective communication.
riasec_fit_block.interest: What this career develops most is reliability and patience: mail must be organized clearly, system entries must be accurate, and customers must receive considerate answers. It suits careful, patient people who trust processes and enjoy the satisfaction of delivering mail reliably.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers practical, orderly, and helping work (Realistic R + Conventional C + Enterprising E).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「稳妥 + 细心 + 服务心」凑一块的人——件要理得清也要送得准，流程和服务要平衡也要会沟通。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「稳妥与耐心」——件要理得清，系统要录得准，客户要答得柔。适合细心、坐得住、对流程有信仰的人，也享受把邮件稳妥送达的踏实感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好务实、守序、也助人（现实 R + 常规 C + 企业 E）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career combines patience + empathy + stability. Improvement appears in details, and you must withstand setbacks.
riasec_fit_block.interest: This career develops patience and awareness. A patient's condition hides in details, and aides must notice an unusual comment or an evasive glance. It suits steady, empathetic people who accept slow progress and enjoy seeing someone gradually stabilize.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Prefers helping others, practical work, and creativity (Social S + Realistic R + Artistic A).

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合把「耐心 + 同理 + 稳」凑一块的人——病人的好转藏在细节里，你得接得住反复。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最练「耐心和觉察」——病人的状态藏在细节里，一句反常的话、一个躲闪的眼神都得接住。适合稳得住、有同理、不怕慢的人，也享受看到人一点点稳下来的过程。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 偏好助人、也务实、也创造（社会 S + 现实 R + 艺术 A）。

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who take others' difficulties seriously. Helping an older adult receive benefits and connecting resources for a family are small acts that accumulate into a meaningful life.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The most meaningful reward in this field is being needed. An older adult receives benefits because of your help, and a struggling family recovers through resources you connected. These concrete changes provide the work's greatest motivation.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Social S + Enterprising E + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「把别人的难处放在心上」的人——帮一位老人办成补贴、为一个家庭对接上资源，这些具体的小事，日积月累就是一份有分量的人生。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行最打动人心的回报是「被需要」：一位独居老人因为你帮忙申请到了补贴，一个困难家庭因为你对接的资源缓过一口气——这些具体的改变，就是做这行最大的动力。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 社会型 S + 企业型 E + 常规型 C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This field suits people who take satisfaction in holding the line. Every inspection performed correctly reinforces their professional value.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The value of this work is direct: one extra look can stop a threat. People who like standardized procedures, can withstand repetition and pressure, and want stable employment can find their place here.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Realistic R + Conventional C + Social S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合享受「把防线守住」的人——每一次规范检查，都是在给自己的岗位背书。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的价值感很直接——你多盯一眼，可能就拦住一次风险。喜欢标准化流程、能扛住重复与压力、又想要稳定编制的人，会在这里找到自己的位置。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 实际型 R + 事务型 C + 社会型 S

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: This career suits people with steady hands, careful minds, and the confidence to operate. After an endoscopic procedure, hearing a patient say they feel much better is the best reward.
riasec_fit_block.interest: The appeal of this field is combining thought with action. Interpreting images and choosing plans require analysis, while endoscopic surgery requires manual skill. Physicians must also discuss concerns patients find embarrassing. People who enjoy the directness of surgery and are willing to listen patiently can find balance in urology.
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: Investigative I + Realistic R + Conventional C

riasec_fit_block.fit_interest: 这行适合「手稳、心细、敢上手」的人——一台腔镜手术做下来，患者说句「感觉好多了」，就是最好的回报。
riasec_fit_block.interest: 这行的魅力在「既动脑又动手」：读片、定方案要动脑，腔镜手术要动手，还要会跟患者聊那些「不好意思说」的问题。喜欢外科的干脆利落，又愿意花时间听患者讲难言之隐的人，会在泌尿外科找到平衡感。
riasec_fit_block.riasec_short: 研究型 I + 实际型 R + 事务型 C
